name: ToolbarButton
summary: Button tuned for use inside a Toolbar.

props.name: variant
props.description: Ghost by default: inside a toolbar the surface already frames the action.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Herdado do Button. Quanto peso a caixa tem; o default aqui é ghost.

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | brand | danger | success | warning | info
props.description: Herdado do Button. O que a cor significa; todas as células existem.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Toggle inside the toolbar (bold, italic). aria-pressed, not a variant.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Same icon API as Button; every Button prop is accepted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stays in the roving order but is not activatable, so the set does not shift.

props.name: size
props.description: The system's size step, shared with Button. Responsive.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an <a> instead of a <button>: a toolbar item that NAVIGATES has to be a link, or middle-click and open-in-new-tab stop working.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the spinner and sets aria-busy.

props.name: kbd
props.description: Shows the shortcut and announces it with aria-keyshortcuts.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fills the width of the container.

props.name: grow
props.description: In a row (Cluster), takes an equal share with the other buttons that also grow (C-03). `fullWidth` asks for the whole line instead.

props.name: target
props.description: Link attribute, only with `href` (C-13). It always reached the <a> at runtime; now the type accepts it, so target="_blank" compiles.
